newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Oil, Mitsui Mining in legal dispute.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Oil, Mitsui Mining in legal dispute.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd and Mitsui Mining Co Ltd are in a legal dispute over oil deals in which Mitsubishi allegedly funnelled a total of 2.4 billion yen to a petroleum dealer, according to court papers.
Mitsui Mining said that Mitsubishi Oil had asked it to cooperate in a scheme in which Mitsui secretly provided money to a western Japan oil dealer in financial trouble through bogus oil deals.
It says that Mitsubishi Oil guaranteed that it would later reimburse Mitsui for the losses in the transactions with the dealer.
Mitsui originally made the charges on Thursday in an affidavit that is part of a civil lawsuit filed in a Tokyo court in July. They were confirmed by a company spokesman on Friday.
Mitsubishi Oil denied that it had been involved in any funnelling of money to the dealer.
In the lawsuit, Mitsui is seeking repayment of loans it made to the dealer that were guaranteed by Mitsubishi Oil. The size of the loans was not disclosed.
The next hearing in the case is scheduled for December 2.
